title: Pingelapese language
extract: The Pingelapese language is a Micronesian language native to Pingelap, an atoll in the state of Pohnpei in the Federated States of Micronesia. This atoll is the homeland of the Pingelapese people, consisting of a three-square-mile (7.8 km2) range of uninhabited small coral islets, Daekae and Sukora, and the inhabited islet, Pingelap. These islands partially make up the Caroline Islands.
